title: Contents Packout & Storage Closing Payment: Recoverable Depreciation Withheld by the Carrier
content:
Recoverable depreciation the carrier withheld on the contents coverage and will not pay the company stays with the customer. For the closing payment on an insurance-funded Contents Packout & Storage job: **when the arrangement bills denied lines to the customer and depreciation forfeited write-offs on the contents coverage are recorded on the linked claim file, the closing payment carries those write-offs; when that does not hold and depreciation releases on the contents coverage were issued to the insured only, it carries those releases, which the insured pays the company from; in every other case nothing is added.**

| Billing arrangement of the Insurance Claim Services claim file bills denied lines to the customer | Depreciation forfeited write-offs on the contents coverage | Depreciation releases on the contents coverage issued to the insured only | Closing payment carries |
|---|---|---|---|
| yes | recorded | any | those write-offs |
| yes | none | recorded | those releases |
| no | any | recorded | those releases |
| otherwise | — | none | nothing |

**Cases (hypothetical figures).** Arrangement bills denied lines, forfeited write-offs 520.00: 520.00. Arrangement does not bill denied lines, a 700.00 depreciation release paid to the insured only: 700.00.
